Shantungosaurus

Shantungosaurus is a genus of Dinosauria placed in Edmontosaurini in Phylosaur's classification. This page shows where it sits in the dinosaur family tree.

Phylosaur is a daily game: you identify a hidden genus by following clues through this family tree. Genera are ranked by how well known they are, from Level I (very familiar) to Level V (rarely heard of). Shantungosaurus is Level II.

Classifications follow the Phylosaur database, built from The Taxonomicon and reviewed against other sources. They change as research advances. Fossil details cite the papers listed on each page.
